inputs: wiki-host/main-guides/corpus-plan.json and its 329 compiled wikitext files
provenance: Recorded from the completed read-only full-corpus conversion audit in the frontend chat. The audit was not rerun to create this artifact.
literalTextComparison: Each nonempty original <nowiki> node was found byte-for-byte in the converted output, in source order, independently for every page.
mediaComparison: Every corpus-plan media entry's src URL was present in the converted page. This export check measures URL coverage; the separate parser audit measures rendered media order and attributes.
limitations: Images, videos and embeds are portable external references; no RuneScape Wiki File titles or imports are invented.
This artifact records compiled-source export coverage, not a live publication or current-game accuracy review.
No synthetic test cases or test suite were written or run.
